subject: numerical_ability
question: A can do a piece of work in 10 days and B can do it in 15 days. How long will they take if both work together?
explanation: Work done by A in 1 day = 1/10. By B in 1 day = 1/15. Together = 1/10 + 1/15 = 5/30 = 1/6. Total days = 6.
